top_signals.title: India’s HPCL Struggles to Secure Oil Tankers as Hormuz Risks Persist
top_signals.summary: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL), a major Indian state-owned refiner, is struggling to hire tankers to transit the Strait of Hormuz and pick up cargoes in the Gulf, chairman Vikas Kaushal has told Bloomberg.
